UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User fitness targets and body metrics for calorie burn estimation.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

dailyProteinGoal.description: Daily post-workout protein target in grams (20 to 400).

bodyWeightKg.description: User body weight in kilograms for accurate calorie calculation (30 to 250).

reminderEnabled.description: Whether daily browser workout reminders are enabled.

reminderTime.description: Scheduled daily reminder time in 24-hour HH:MM format.

reminderPushUpType.description: Preferred push-up variation launched by the daily reminder.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

WorkoutSet.title: WorkoutSet
WorkoutSet.description: A completed push-up workout set with muscle target, timer duration, and calories burned.

dateKey.description: Local calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

setNumber.description: Sequential set number for the day (1 to 100).

reps.description: Number of push-up repetitions completed (1 to 2000).

durationMs.description: Elapsed set duration in milliseconds (0 to 7200000).

caloriesBurned.description: Estimated kilocalories burned during the set (0 to 5000).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the set was logged.

ProteinLog.title: ProteinLog
ProteinLog.description: Post-push-up protein food or drink logged by the user.

dateKey.description: Local calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

foodName.description: Name of the protein food or drink.

relatedSetId.description: Optional workout set ID associated with this post-workout meal.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the protein intake was logged.

/users/{userId}.description: Private fitness profile and daily goals owned by a single user.

/users/{userId}/workoutSets/{setId}.description: Completed push-up workout sets for the user.

/users/{userId}/proteinLogs/{logId}.description: Post-push-up protein foods logged by the user.
